call_basis: Call rule (ROUTINE.md hard rule 6), judged at the Rs 200 upper band: Neutral value Rs 176 is 11.7% below (within 10-30%) and the Bull value Rs 215 is above the price, so the call is Neutral. At the Rs 190 floor the Neutral value is 7.1% below, which would read Subscribe. No material issue was found in the data available. Figures come from public trackers because the RHP was not reachable.
reference_note: Upper band Rs 200 (28,00,800 fresh shares, Rs 56.02 cr). At Rs 200: market cap Rs 211.4 cr post-issue; P/E 15.75x on FY26 PAT (11.58x pre-issue); P/B 2.51x post-issue; EV/EBITDA about 9.9x. Peer median P/E 20.2x. Objects floor Rs 159.
headline: A Gujarat low-voltage cable maker that has grown revenue 2.4x in two years to Rs 210 cr and lifted EBITDA margin to 11.4%, priced at 15.8x FY26 earnings against a 20x SME-cable peer median; our fair value is Rs 176 (Neutral) because growth has been funded by debt and working capital, leaving little free cash flow.
red_flags: Revenue Rs 88.95 cr (FY24) -> Rs 140.00 cr -> Rs 210.47 cr (FY26); PAT Rs 2.52 cr -> Rs 5.46 cr -> Rs 13.42 cr; EBITDA margin 6.1% -> 8.7% -> 11.4%
Borrowings Rs 79.88 cr against net worth Rs 31.44 cr (2.54x) in FY26, up 91% in a year; total assets almost doubled to Rs 126.64 cr
FY26 margin is the first year at this level; copper-price moves and a fragmented LV cable market can compress it
Fresh issue only (Rs 56.02 cr): new shed, plant, conductor machinery, rooftop solar and Rs 14 cr working capital
RHP not reachable: figures from public trackers, no page cites; fair value Rs 141 / 176 / 215 vs Rs 200

strengths: Revenue CAGR 54% FY24-26 to Rs 210.47 cr
Wide LV range: power, control, building, solar, submersible and welding cables
Two plants in Mehsana, 79,950 km a year installed
weaknesses: Thin cash generation: working capital absorbs profit
Small scale against national cable brands
opportunities: Housing, infrastructure and solar demand for LV cables
Paper-insulated conductors for transformer makers (new line)
threats: Price competition from organised and unorganised makers
